verdict.rationale: Netlify ships an official CLI (netlify-cli) whose documented `netlify deploy` command deploys sites from the terminal and working directory. Anonymous deploys are supported, so no dashboard step is needed. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI deploys; the community evidence covers Git-based auto-deploys and Netlify Dev, not `netlify deploy`.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my project directly from the command line without using a web dashboard

citations.quote: Deploy sites, run local dev servers, and manage your Netlify projects right from the terminal with this powerful command-line tool.
Deploy directly from your working directory. No login required to start.
